scope: User-directed narrated explanation and TR02 design study; preserves selected FT02 order files
user_direction: Adding inward tabs does not move foam or consume its support margin.
Loose locating slots are acceptable; visually align the backing, then retain it with an appropriate bonding/retention detail.
The relevant water risk is shower spray entering the wall cavity, not supply-water leakage.
Investigate a modestly smaller aperture to add inward support beneath the existing foam without moving the foam.
Use both installed Polycam captures; respect strong coplanar factory-plate calipers and separate 3D installed end distances.
The narrated video must also show the proposed temporary formwork.
design_interpretation: Keep outer diameter 220 mm. Add tabs locally and compare 0, 1, and 2 mm inward boundary offsets, rather than increasing the outside circle.
best_current_direction: 2 mm inward support with loose tabs is a promising trial candidate in the tested working pose. It is not yet substituted into order packages.
measurement_requests: None. Ordinary physical fit, removal, retention, handle and contact checks remain separate from machining measurements.
formwork: Show existing RF01 CAD without alteration: optional temporary one-piece PETG face/collar, rear fill only outside collar, forward withdrawal. Full face seating, support, liner release and service paths are unproved physical conditions.
no_actions: No new vendor upload or purchase
No change to primary scan transform
